-- ── Close button logic ───────────────────────────────
closeBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
    closeBtn:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 14), "Out", "Quad", 0.2, true)
end)

closeBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
    closeBtn:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 12), "Out", "Quad", 0.2, true)
end)

closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    closeBtn:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10), "Out", "Quad", 0.1, true)
    task.wait(0.2)
    closeBtn:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 12), "Out", "Quad", 0.1, true)
    
    task.wait(0.1)
    mainFrame:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0), "Out", "Quad", 0.3, true)
    task.wait(0.3)
    screenGui:Destroy()
end)
